meta.title: The Island That Existed on Maps for 100 Years But Was Never Real #shorts
meta.description:
Imagine sailing to a tropical island marked on every world map, only to find yourself floating over miles of empty ocean. In 2012, scientists decided to visit Sandy Island, a landmass near New Caledonia charted since 1876. Even Google Maps showed a solid, dark landmass sitting in the Coral Sea. But when the expedition reached the exact coordinates, there were no trees, no sand, and no land. Just pure, deep water. For over a century, mapmakers simply copied an old sailing captain's mistake without checking it. Overnight, an entire island vanished from global records forever. What weird glitch or hidden secret do you think is still hiding on world maps today? Tell me in the comments and follow for more wild true stories!
